checks.name: floating-point-format-and-precision
checks.requirement: Format, radix, precision, unit roundoff, exponent range, and normal/subnormal distinctions match the source.

checks.name: rounding-and-operation-model
checks.requirement: Rounding mode, per-operation error model, fused operations, exact operations, and independence or stochastic assumptions match.

checks.name: exceptional-values-and-range
checks.requirement: Overflow, underflow, subnormals, flush-to-zero, infinities, NaNs, signed zero, and range hypotheses match or are explicitly classified.

checks.name: real-versus-machine-semantics
checks.requirement: Real-number equalities and inequalities are not used as substitutes for machine execution unless the source makes that abstraction.
